gaps.reason: A suppression binds to a declaration, and this kind's subject is a replace directive of the module file, so no ignore entry and no inline directive suppresses the finding: an entry naming one is reported as a stale suppression instead. The remedy is deleting the directive, whose target is absent from the build list. Setting the severity of DS1605 to allow silences the kind.

A suppression binds to a declaration, and this kind's subject is a requirement of the module file, so no ignore entry and no inline directive suppresses the finding: an entry naming one is reported as a stale suppression instead. The remedy is go mod tidy, which removes the requirement. Setting the severity of DS1601 to allow silences the kind.
